selective_top1.description: Accuracy on the images the model answered; null if none.
selective_top1.title: Selective Top1

Attribution.description: Rights and provenance required for every published educational claim or asset.
Attribution.title: Attribution

Citation.description: A citation is an attribution attached to a claim.
Citation.title: Citation

ModelBenchmarkRun.description:
One model version guessing every photo of a fixed photo set, before any answer.

``photo_set_id`` names the exact set of photo rounds, so runs are compared only on the
same photos. Only the totals are stored and returned, never a per-photo answer.
ModelBenchmarkRun.title: ModelBenchmarkRun

ModelBenchmarks.description: All benchmark runs, oldest first, and whether the enabled model can run one now.
ModelBenchmarks.title: ModelBenchmarks

ModelEvaluation.description:
Held-out results recorded when the enabled model was trained; read-only, offline.

The summary comes from the hash-checked manifest. Per-country rows come from the run's
``report.json`` and are shown only when that report agrees with the manifest.
ModelEvaluation.title: ModelEvaluation

ModelInfo.description: Identity of the local prediction provider; learning never requires one.
ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo

ModelPredictionResult.description: A post-answer model opinion for one attempt; never source truth and never a hint.
ModelPredictionResult.title: ModelPredictionResult

ModelStatus.description: Which provider is enabled; ``active`` is null when the app runs without a model.
ModelStatus.title: ModelStatus

PhotoGuessResult.description:
The model's opinion on a learner's own photo. Nothing is stored and nothing is graded:
the photo has no authored answer, so this is never source truth.
PhotoGuessResult.title: PhotoGuessResult

PracticeAnswerResult.description: Post-submission reveal with deterministic scoring and a local attempt identity.
PracticeAnswerResult.title: PracticeAnswerResult

PracticeClue.description: An optional authored clue, distinct from the hidden answer.
PracticeClue.title: PracticeClue

PracticeRoundPublic.description: Pre-submission contract deliberately omitting both answer and coordinates.
PracticeRoundPublic.title: PracticeRoundPublic

RaceAvailability.description: Whether a race can start now; ``reason`` says why not, in words for the learner.
RaceAvailability.title: RaceAvailability

RaceHistory.description: Finished races, newest first, with totals overall and per model version.
RaceHistory.title: RaceHistory

RaceModelRecord.description: The learner's record against one model version.
RaceModelRecord.title: RaceModelRecord

RacePlayer.description: Who races the model: the learner, or a class guessing together on a projector.
RacePlayer.title: RacePlayer

RaceRoundPublic.description: One race round before the answer: the public round only, never its answer.
RaceRoundPublic.title: RaceRoundPublic

RaceRoundResult.description: The reveal of one race round: the answer, both guesses and the points.

model_prediction.description: Null when the model failed on this round.

RaceRoundResult.title: RaceRoundResult

RaceRoundSummary.description: A row of the race table; answer fields stay null until that round is answered.
RaceRoundSummary.title: RaceRoundSummary

RaceStartRequest.description:
``time_limit_seconds`` is per round; null means no limit, as in GeoGuessr's settings.
A ``class`` race records the class's answers but leaves the learner's study review alone.
RaceStartRequest.title: RaceStartRequest

RaceTally.description: Finished races only: points and wins, the learner against the model.
RaceTally.title: RaceTally

SourceTruthAnswer.description: Pack-authored ground truth; never derived from learner or model activity.
SourceTruthAnswer.title: SourceTruthAnswer

StudyProgress.description: SM-2 review state for one practice round, derived only from local attempts.

next_review_on.description: The due date the review queue is ordered by.
next_review_on.title: Next Review On

StudyProgress.title: StudyProgress

StudyReview.description: The next local review; an empty queue is an expected clean-start state.
StudyReview.title: StudyReview

get.description: Serve one verified photo of the local photo pack; its name reveals nothing.

post.description: Persist local feedback; reports remain separate from verified source truth.

get.description: Report that the local API process is accepting requests.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.description: Report the optional local model; ``active`` is null when none is enabled.
Each model version's score on the fixed set of race photos, for the progress graph.

post.description: Run the enabled model over the fixed photo set once; 409 when it cannot race.

get.description: Held-out accuracy recorded when the enabled model was trained; 404 when there is none.
Expose the starter pack and any verified local photo pack, without an install flow.

post.description:
Ask the local model about the learner's own photo: a top-3 guess or an abstention.

The photo is the raw request body. It is held in memory for this request only and is
never written to disk or the database.

get.description: Return the model's post-answer opinion; it requires an answered or skipped attempt.
Serve the next diagram or photo round; answers never leave this route before submission.
Reopen one round's public payload, e.g. for a scheduled review; no answer is included.

post.description: Persist the pseudonymous attempt and its review schedule, then reveal the answer.

get.description: Reveal only the optional authored clue; this never releases the answer.

post.description: Start a race of photo rounds against the enabled model; 409 when it cannot race.

get.description: Say whether a race can start; races need a real model and enough photo rounds.
Finished races and your record against each model version; never a round's answer.
The race table and score; answers appear only for rounds already answered.
Open a race round (its public payload only) and start its clock.

post.description: Record the learner's guess as a practice attempt, then reveal it with the model's.

get.description: Return persisted pseudonymous SM-2 state for one practice round.
Return the earliest-due local review without inventing one on clean start.
